verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਮਜੀਠ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਸੈ ਖੋਦਿ ਕਾਢੀਅਤ ਅੰਬਰ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਭਏ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਤਜਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau majeeTh basudhaa sai khodh kaaddeeat a(n)bar sura(n)g bhe sa(n)g na tajat hai ||

en.bdb: As the red colouring agent of a Rubiaceous plant is extracted from the bottom part of its stem, and the clothes coloured with it become beautiful to behold, while the colour does not fade;

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਤਜਿ ਮੂਲ ਫੂਲ ਆਨੀਅਤ ਜਾਨੀਅਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਤਾਹੀ ਭਜਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau kasu(n)bh taj mool fool aaneeat jaaneeat sa(n)g chhaadd taahee bhajat hai ||

en.bdb: As the colour of Safflower plant resides in the flower and not in the lower part of the stem, so it is believed to leave or fade away when a cloth is dyed with it, since that is its character;

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਮੁਖ ਸਲਿਲ ਸੂਚੀ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਸੀਤ ਤਪਤਿ ਮਲ ਅਮਲ ਸਜਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aradh uradh mukh salil soochee subhaau taa(n) te seet tapat mal amal sajat hai ||

en.bdb: As the water flows downward while the fire extends upward, the fire is heat and soot-giving while water is cool and free of dross or dirt.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਨੀਚ ਊਚ ਜੀਤ ਹਾਰ ਹਾਰ ਜੀਤ ਲਜਾ ਨ ਲਜਤ ਹੈ ॥੧੩੬॥
verses.translit_en: gurmat dhuramat uooch neech neech uooch jeet haar haar jeet lajaa na lajat hai ||136||

en.bdb: The teachings of the Guru raise the consciousness of the humble, convert defeat into victory, and make a person honorable but base wisdom lowers the arrogant, converts victory into defeat, and makes a person bereft of shame and honour. (136)
